step by step agar ek dum new vs code hoga kisi ka or pr usmai bs pyhton install ho to kaise run karega ye batao

Naye PC par VS Code aur Python installed hon, to project chalane ke liye yeh steps follow karo. Internet connection aur AI features ke liye Gemini API key bhi chahiye.

1. Project folder VS Code mein kholo: File → Open Folder se woh folder kholo jismein app.py hai. Phir Terminal → New Terminal kholo.

2. Python check karo:
```powershell
python --version
```
Agar version number na aaye, Windows par yeh try karo:
```powershell
py --version
```

3. Virtual environment banao aur activate karo:
```powershell
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
```
Agar python command kaam na kare, dono commands mein python ki jagah py use karo. Activation block ho to agle step mein .venv\Scripts\python.exe seedha use kar sakte ho.

4. Zaroori packages install karo:
```powershell
python -m pip install Flask google-genai python-dotenv
```

5. AI key set karo: Project folder mein app.py ke paas .env file banao aur apni Gemini API key rakho:
```dotenv
GEMINI_API_KEY=apni_gemini_api_key
```
API key private rakho. Key ke bina website khul sakti hai, lekin AI features kaam nahi karenge.

6. App start karo:
```powershell
python app.py
```
Browser mein http://127.0.0.1:5000/ kholo. Terminal chalta rehna chahiye; server band karne ke liye Ctrl+C dabao.

Har naye PC par virtual environment, dependencies aur Gemini key setup karni hogi. Project mein requirements.txt file nahi hai, isliye packages upar diye gaye command se install karo.
